text: We started sending our child to Chunga-Changa kindergarten at the end of February. In March, we were informed that the kindergarten was closed until the 10th, and later that there was no exact opening date yet. Our child attended the kindergarten for only six days, even though we had paid for a full month. The organizer, Alina Shabasheva, hasn't responded to requests for a recalculation or refund for unused days—neither messages nor calls. Unfortunately, this left a very unpleasant impression. I recommend being careful when choosing.

We were looking for our daughter's first preschool (1.6 years old) while wintering in Thailand. We were very lucky to find one here, as she had a very smooth adaptation; we literally carried her in our arms. 🥰😍🙏
A huge thank you to our teacher, Svetlana. Our daughter saw her as a friend and an authority figure, and she fell in love with her. Svetlana held many lessons with her - we developed fine motor skills, did speech therapy, and I learned many life hacks for how I could continue to work with my daughter independently in the future. I never would have thought of this on my own. The teacher constantly sent video reports.
Thanks to the teacher, Natalia, in my opinion, she's the funniest teacher in the kindergarten. I think, thanks to Natalia, my daughter learned discipline and is more willing to do warm-up exercises with everyone else and learned new dance moves.
Also, thanks to Alina for organizing the entire process and smoothly adapting my husband and I to the kindergarten. She was always in touch and answered all our questions and concerns during the admissions process. We made the right decision when we decided to entrust our treasure to you.
In the future, when we choose kindergartens for admission, we will have much higher standards and requirements after such a great approach. in Chunga-chang😁😁🙏❤️❤️❤️
The best kindergarten ever! Qualified teachers, high-quality and varied meals, and all kinds of activities for the kids. My child is so happy, he doesn't even want to leave when I pick him up. :)

This year, we were on vacation and needed help with childcare and development for our children, who are close in age. We chose this preschool. At the beginning, there was a program to introduce our children to an unfamiliar environment and teachers. We took the plunge and haven't regretted it one bit. The meals, games, and activities were all top-notch. Each of our little ones received attention and care. The children didn't want to leave. Unfortunately, the vacation is over, but we'll definitely be back and wouldn't hesitate to contact such professionals again! Thank you for your hard work and for our children. We wish you prosperity and all the best!

We paid for a month's visit, but a week later the garden unexpectedly closed. The organizer, Alina, didn't respond to requests for a refund, and later, contact with her was blocked. During opening hours, the garden was often closed from the outside, raising doubts about the legality of its activities. An unpleasant experience.
The kindergarten is fantastic! The teachers are very good. The classes are good, and my child's progress is visible from the first week. My little one is thrilled and runs there with joy.

A really cool kindergarten with lots of extracurricular activities. 👍🏻👍🏻It's a shame we only went for two weeks. We're hoping to get a spot in January. 🤗🤗 We love everything, our child is thrilled! 🤩🤩 …
